title: OBSERVED
tagline: A citizen observatory: pick an experiment, predict first, measure with your phone, inspect the evidence.
stateNote: Runs locally. The seeded demo campaign is clearly labelled as simulated.
problem: People argue about basics like the shape of the Earth from their sofas. OBSERVED asks them to lock a prediction, measure a shadow or a sunset, and see every model scored against open data.
audience: Curious people, teachers and skeptics who prefer evidence they can recompute themselves.
contribution: It is my project. The README describes a signed, hash-chained record of observations, and the evidence page recomputes statistics in your browser.
worksToday: Two experiments are described end to end: The Shadow Stick and One Sunset, Everywhere.
The README lists tests for the physics and for tamper and forgery checks.
limitations: I haven't run the tests or the app. This summary comes from the README.
The README's own 'Honest limits' section notes the system can't prove a shadow was real.

ai.note: Commit trailers show Claude as a co-author.
